text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe's farmers are expected to produce between 2.4 million and 2.6 million tonnes of maize this season, enough for all local needs with a surplus for strategic stocks or for export.
- The share price of Zimbabwe Newspapers jumped 1,700 cents up on Tuesday to close at a record 5,900 cents after the announcement of excellent results for the year ended December 1996.

- State-owned Air Zimbabwe -- whose pilots and flight engineers went on strike last Friday to press for higher salaries -- and private airline Zimbabwe Express both delayed their flights to the second city of Bulawayo on Tuesday night when their respective leased aircrafts developed problems.

- Zimbabwe's transport and energy minister Simon Moyo on Tuesday urged Air Zimbabwe's striking pilots and flight engineers to return to work, stressing that commercialisation of the troubled airline would ensure better remuneration packages and conditions of service.
